plan.notes: Source: Alexandria Technical & Community College 2025-2026 Catalog (official PDF, updated August 25, 2025), 'Business Management' Certificate, Total Credits: 19 / PROGRAM CREDITS: 19. Hand-transcribed 2026-10-01. The catalog publishes no term-by-term split for this certificate; courses are recorded as a single requirements block as published. The COMM/ENGL Elective (GE) draws from the catalog's Elective box: Interpersonal Communication (COMM1435 3), Composition I (ENGL1410 3), Technical Writing (ENGL1460 3). The Technical Electives (TE) draw from the same box: Microsoft Excel & Access Applications (ACCT1610 3), Principles of Accounting II (ACCT2010 4), Business Law (BUS2200 3), Business Math (MKTG1507 3), Advertising & Sales Promotion (MKTG1511 3), Selling Principles & Practices (MKTG1515 3).
